12/ago (dia 13, ultima practica abierta: 8/12 (day 13, last open practice before the preseason debut): Sanders took ALL the first-team reps; Deshaun Watson got most of the second-team snaps with Dillon Gabriel rotating. Sanders threw a rollout touchdown to Blake Whiteheart in the red zone, connected with Isaiah Bond in 11-on-11 and led a successful two-minute drill with throws to Harold Fannin Jr., Denzel Boston and Bond. Cameron Wolfe reported Sanders and Watson will alternate as preseason starters. A verifiable change in first-team reps.
12/ago: recepcion de Sanders por el cent: 8/12: a catch from Sanders over the middle in 11-on-11 and another along the sideline in the two-minute drill with the first team. These are isolated plays from a single practice, with no staff comment and no depth chart change.
16/ago: varias ganancias largas apoyado: 8/16: several long gains behind fullback Connor Heyward, who played 13 snaps in the preseason debut. This is a scheme note (more fullback personnel), not a role change: he is already the starting back.
17/ago: Breece Hall salio temprano de la: 8/17: Breece Hall left practice early with a groin injury and Allen became the lead back for the rest of the session, with 2 red-zone touchdowns and most of the workload. Aaron Glenn downplayed it: “I don't think it's a big deal, but I want to make sure we get the evaluation.” Hall was going for imaging. A real bump, but contingent on an injury the head coach played down.
17/ago: multiples conexiones con Geno Sm: 8/17: multiple connections with Geno Smith, with targets up because Garrett Wilson was ill. On 8/11, in the joint practice against Tampa Bay, Matt Verderame reported he “got open repeatedly” despite Smith's inaccuracy. Two consistent reports, but the volume is inflated by Wilson's absence.

Aaron Wilson reporto que Dell volvio a p: Aaron Wilson reported Dell practiced IN PADS for the first time since his 2024 injury. DeMeco Ryans: “Tank is on the right plan. Every day depends on how he feels.” A real health milestone, but no confirmed role or first-team reps.
Alex Kozora (4/ago, dia 6): su mejor dia: Alex Kozora (8/4, day 6): his best day of camp, finally “breaking out with high-impact plays” after being targeted often; two touchdowns from Rodgers in the red-zone period. One good practice day, nothing more.
Con Tua Tagovailoa ya en Atlanta, Willis: With Tua Tagovailoa now in Atlanta, Willis is running the offense in the practice notebooks: day 9 (8/8) two 20-plus-yard throws escaping the pocket and a rushing touchdown; day 10 (8/10) completions into tight coverage and a connection with rookie Caleb Douglas on a bootleg right under pressure. He sits atop the first preseason depth chart. There is no explicit staff confirmation that he is the Week 1 QB1.
Con peto de no contacto: individuales, 7: In a non-contact jersey: individuals, 7-on-7 and limited 11-on-11. Caught 3 passes in 7-on-7 including a 20-yard leaping grab; ran extra routes with the medical staff. Tracking toward Week 1.
Confirmado como titular del primer juego: Confirmed as the starter for the first preseason game against Denver, with Cooper Rush and Jack Strand rotating. Michael Penix Jr. still cannot do 11-on-11 (mostly 7-on-7 reps) and did not dress for that game. QB coach Alex Van Pelt: “the last three or four days he's really come on.”
Conor Ryan (16/ago): paso buena parte de: Conor Ryan (8/16): he spent much of early camp with the THIRD team, but Vrabel defended him publicly: “I know full well Kyle is going to help us. His speed is going to help us... I know he's going to be a big part of what we do.” After the preseason debut against Indianapolis (2 catches, 37 yards, a touchdown) Vrabel added: “You were all laughing when I told you the other day.” A role declared by the coach, but no promotion on the depth chart yet.
Debut de pretemporada con 145 yardas, 1: Preseason debut with 145 yards, 1 touchdown and no turnovers in the 24-20 loss to Jacksonville. No staff comment that changes the quarterback pecking order.
Descrito como 'catching everything throw: Described as “catching everything thrown his way” as he chases a second-year jump. Camp praise with no rep detail and no role change.
Dia 10 (10/ago): atrapo los 4 reps que l: Day 10 (8/10): caught all 4 of his one-on-one reps, a deep touchdown from Willis and a tough grab in traffic during team period. All in practice, with no confirmed first-team reps and no role change. Classic camp noise.
Dia 10 (11/ago): atrapo un TD de Joe Fla: Day 10 (8/11): caught a touchdown from Joe Flacco and looked improved as a receiver. He said: “Making guys miss in space, being explosive after the catch... that's a focus for taking another step.” Behind Chase Brown, with no first-team reps reported.
Dia 10 (11/ago): dos recepciones profund: Day 10 (8/11): two deep catches from Allen, one down the right sideline for an untouched touchdown and another up the seam, showing he is back from injury. Coordinator Jim Leonhard called him an “absolute playmaker.” No depth chart change: this is a good practice day from a veteran returning from injury.
Dos TD de zona roja el 8/8 saltando sobr: Two red-zone touchdowns on 8/8 going up over defenders, on throws from Caleb Williams and Bagent. Continued hype, with no reported role change.
Encabeza un grupo de seis TE en el prime: He tops a six-man tight end group on the first depth chart. Patra projects him for a “massive target share” because the receiver room is decimated: Alec Pierce, Josh Downs and Laquon Treadwell have all missed practice time. The opportunity is structural and verifiable, though the volume projection is still the writer's.
Eric Smith (16/ago): recepcion de mas de: Eric Smith (8/16): a 40-plus-yard catch from Herbert in full team period, but he lost the ball after going down untouched and the staff used it as a teaching moment. An eye-catching play with an asterisk.
Eric Smith (16/ago, dia 14): atrapo un T: Eric Smith (8/16, day 14): caught a 20-yard touchdown from Justin Herbert in red-zone work, alongside another 12-yard score by Ladd McConkey. One practice play; no unit or rep information.
Etiquetado como 'the training camp stand: Labeled “the training camp standout.” He beat Kelee Ringo in one-on-ones and caught a low ball from Hurts. He is also in the kick return rotation. This is still a roster fight, not a target fight.
Figura como TE titular en el primer dept: He is listed as the starting tight end on the first unofficial depth chart (8/10, Eric Allen) and the path cleared because Kenyon Sadiq (the No. 16 overall pick) is not practicing after hernia surgery. In the joint practice against the Bucs he caught a leaping red-zone touchdown and receivers coach Shawn Jefferson said he “will be a very good Robin to our Batman.” On 8/17 he nearly scored again, pushed out at the 1.
Firmado recientemente y elogiado por Mik: Recently signed and praised by Mike McCarthy, who said he is “having a heck of a camp” and called him “an excellent signing”; Pat Freiermuth backed him as a veteran. He is still TE2 behind Freiermuth: irrelevant for fantasy barring an injury.
HC Dave Canales confirmó que jugaría con: HC Dave Canales confirmed he would play with the first offensive group in Buffalo, rotating with Chuba Hubbard: “he'll play with the first group, he'll mix in and out with Chuba.” His first game since 2024 after two ACLs. He has been a full participant in camp.
Ha sido foco de la ofensiva en practicas: He has been a focal point of the offense in practice and Drake Maye praised him (“he keeps doing things the right way”); Vrabel said he is open to keeping seven receivers. But Patra notes Boutte is LOSING reps with A.J. Brown's arrival. He still flashes on deep balls, with no real promotion.
Jared Koch (3/ago, primera practica con: Jared Koch (8/3, first padded practice): back-to-back touchdowns, including one in the red zone with C.J. Stroud rolling right. A second-year receiver; no confirmed first-team reps and no staff comment on his role.
Jim Wyatt (15/ago): su mejor dia de prac: Jim Wyatt (8/15): his best practice day, 21 of 25 with five touchdown passes and three consecutive red-zone scores. Patra adds that he is playing “mistake-free football,” an improvement on last year. He is the unquestioned starter, so this is not a promotion: it is evidence of progress.
Levi Edwards (16/ago): el novato de 6a r: Levi Edwards (8/16): the sixth-round rookie “earned increased reps with the FIRST team,” confirmed by head coach Kubiak: “Malik has pushed in... he's earned those reps, but let's keep him humble.” He made “arguably the catch of the day,” winning the ball at its highest point on a go route from Fernando Mendoza. On 8/4 receivers coach Zach Azzanni had already called him “a steal.” A role bump confirmed by the coach.
Lideró a Chicago con 4 recepciones para: Led Chicago with 4 catches for 88 yards (including a 41-yarder) in the preseason debut against Cleveland, and blocked downfield. Caught a 70-plus-yard touchdown from Tyson Bagent in Thursday's practice. OC Press Taylor: “He continues to produce with the opportunities he's been given.”
Lideró a Seattle con 5 recepciones para: Led Seattle with 5 catches for 36 yards and a 5-yard touchdown in the preseason debut (a 17-7 loss to Dallas). Drew Lock: “He's had a great summer,” adding that he should have scored twice because he overthrew him on a 68-yard deep shot.
Matt McMullen (13/ago): fue la estrella: Matt McMullen (8/13): he was the offensive star of the day, “targeted early and often, especially on intermediate throws over the middle,” with sharp timing with Mahomes. He is the expected WR1 and the source is the team site: this confirms health and chemistry, not a promotion.
Michael Greene (10/ago): aparece sorpres: Michael Greene (8/10): he shows up surprisingly as the third starting receiver on the first unofficial depth chart, ahead of Nick Westbrook-Ikhine, with mostly inexperienced depth behind him. It is a depth chart data point, but one opened up by injuries and from a preseason document that is notoriously unreliable.
Novato de 3a ronda. Trabajó ampliamente: Third-round rookie. He worked extensively with the first-team offense on 8/17 and was a frequent Jaxson Dart target. In the preseason debut: 3 catches, 34 yards and a 15-yard touchdown. Dart praised his ability to win contested catches.
Novato de 3a ronda: fue titular y jugó 2: Third-round rookie: he started and played 23 snaps in the preseason debut, 2 catches for 15 yards. Press Taylor said he “made his presence felt in the run game” but flagged room to improve as a receiver.
Novato del que el cuerpo técnico dijo 'n: A rookie the staff said “nobody has covered him yet” because of his receiving ability. He missed the preseason debut with minor lower-body soreness and returned to practice Monday 8/17. Macdonald: “He's on his return plan. It's good to see him out there.”
Novato listado tercero detras de Jonatha: A rookie listed third behind Jonathan Taylor and DJ Giddens (the latter with hamstring trouble). Greene describes him as a camp “bright spot” worth watching closely. No first-team reps and no staff quote.
Novato. En práctica del 5/8 rebotó de tr: Rookie. In the 8/5 practice he bounced off three different defenders before cutting inside in team drills; he also caught a touchdown from Mariota. He scored a short-yardage touchdown in the preseason debut.
Novato. Receptor del mejor lanzamiento d: Rookie. He was on the receiving end of Willis's best throw on 8/10, but on 8/8 CB Jason Marshall Jr. beat him several times with pass breakups. Patra also reports the receiver group is still unsettled and the preseason will sort the order. A mixed signal.
Novato: 21 de 25 para 190 yardas y 2 TD: Rookie: 21 of 25 for 190 yards and 2 touchdowns in his preseason debut; earlier, in the joint practice with Dallas, he threw a touchdown off his back foot. Stetson Bennett IV had been the designated starter for that game and threw two interceptions in the joint session. Stafford is still the starter.
Novato: lideró al equipo en objetivos (8: Rookie: he led the team in targets (8) with 7 catches for 37 yards in the preseason debut against Kansas City. Described as a reliable target within the tight end group.
Nuevo en San Francisco: conexión de 11 y: New to San Francisco: an 11-yard connection with Brock Purdy along the sideline in the red zone and an over-the-shoulder grab between two defenders on Day 13. OC Klay Kubiak: “Mike has the right mindset that he's just out there to get better.”
Patra reporta 'elogios implacables' haci: Patra reports “relentless praise” for him as he climbs as a slot receiver. I found NO daily Jacksonville practice report backing it up: the team's August articles are preseason game pieces and do not mention him. A second-hand quote with no rep or unit detail.
Patra: 'parece posicionado para liderar: Patra: he “looks positioned to lead the backfield over Jaylen Warren.” CAREFUL: this is the writer's read and it is contradicted, because on 8/4 Alex Kozora reported Warren performing well in short yardage and Dowdle only “competent” across several periods, and the 8/16 camp blog offers no ruling on the pecking order. No depth chart supports it.
Patra: 'se vio excelente' a ocho meses d: Patra: he “looked excellent” eight months out from Achilles surgery and is taking ALL the first-team reps. Michael Greene (8/10) confirms he tops the first unofficial depth chart, with Riley Leonard and Anthony Richardson Sr. co-listed as backups, and that Jones sat out Thursday's game against New England precisely so the backups could separate. QB1 confirmed.
Patra: descrito como 'la estrella del ca: Patra: described as “the star of camp” by multiple reporters, before shoulder concerns emerged. Corroborated on the field by Jim Wyatt on 8/15: several touchdowns, including a deep ball where he “left cornerback Alontae Taylor behind.” A consistent signal across several reporters, with a health flag.
Patra: el coordinador ofensivo Mike McDa: Patra: offensive coordinator Mike McDaniel said Hampton has shown “as much growth as any player, if not the most.” A direct coordinator quote about the starting back. It backs the existing role rather than signaling a promotion; no team practice report added rep detail.
Patra: el novato de 4a ronda 'podria reb: Patra: the fourth-round rookie “could pass Andrei Iosivas if he keeps making plays.” That is the writer's projection, not a rep report or a staff quote. Speculative.
Patra: ha impresionado a diario y le da: Patra: he has impressed daily and gives Josh Allen the consistent target he has not had since Diggs. On 8/4 (day 5, first padded practice) he hit a 50-yard touchdown with Allen beating double coverage; Shakir: “it looks fake, that's how pretty that play was.” He is an offseason acquisition already projected as WR1: confirmation, not a promotion.
Patra: luce sano y 'bien' bajo el nuevo: Patra: he looks healthy and “good” under new coordinator Davis Webb. On 8/10 he showed mobility on a run to the perimeter and connected with Pat Bryant and Troy Franklin. An established starter with no change at all: status quo.
Patra: mantiene el rol de doble via, con: Patra: he keeps the two-way role, with an interception and a 35-yard catch showing his versatility. This continues a role already known, not a promotion. No detail on the offensive snap split.
Persigue el rol de RB1 por encima de Aar: He is chasing the RB1 role over Aaron Jones. HC Kevin O'Connell on his physical transformation: “You guys can probably even tell just the way he looks. He's in unbelievable shape right now.”
Primera selección del draft 2026 (pick 3: Their first pick of the 2026 draft (pick 33). Preseason debut: 7 catches for 63 yards, ALL in the first half, and he left the game with nearly 8 minutes still on the second-quarter clock. A 32-yard sideline catch and a third-down conversion with both feet in. Shanahan: “I liked how his hands looked out there and played physical.”
Ray Garvin (4/ago): el novato tomaba sna: Ray Garvin (8/4): the rookie was taking snaps with Patrick Mahomes and the FIRST-team offense, and “Andy Reid says Allen has already earned Mahomes's trust.” But he was carted off on 8/1 with a bone bruise in his shin and remains day to day; Patra confirms him out along with Xavier Worthy (shoulder). First-team reps plus a head coach quote, interrupted by injury.
Ray Garvin (4/ago): la quimica con Cam W: Ray Garvin (8/4): the chemistry with Cam Ward carried from OTAs into camp. Wyatt (8/15): he caught two touchdown passes from Ward in the red zone. A good rookie in a room that also has Ayomanor, Calvin Ridley and Wan'Dale Robinson; no role change reported.
Ray Garvin (4/ago): opera como principal: Ray Garvin (8/4): he operates as the primary vertical threat and is building chemistry with Shedeur Sanders, but he works with the SECOND team when they split fields. On 8/12 he appeared in Sanders's two-minute drill. A good rookie, but still on the second unit.
Receptor reconvertido a TE: dos buenas r: A receiver converted to tight end: two good catches Tuesday and good separation Friday, but with the SECOND-team offense and “a work in progress as a blocker.”
Recibió los dos pases de TD de Ty Simpso: He caught both of Ty Simpson's touchdown passes in the preseason debut. Production against backup units.
Regresó de una lesión de flexor de cader: He returned from a hip flexor injury and caught a deep ball from Purdy in 11-on-11 with a defender draped on him, plus a catch from Mac Jones in one-on-ones. An eye-catching play, no role change.
Regresó del esguince grave de tobillo (2: He returned from the severe ankle sprain (10/26/2025) and played in the preseason debut: 4 carries, 19 yards. HC John Harbaugh: “I thought I saw the Cam Skattebo that you guys all know and saw last year.”
Reportado como 'clearly the WR2' del equ: Reported as “clearly the WR2” on the team. In practice 8 he connected several times in the red zone with Penix and caught a “well-located” deep ball from Tua of more than 20 yards.
Ryan Mink (10/ago): atrapadas de highlig: Ryan Mink (8/10): highlight catches almost daily; a one-handed grab drew 2.2 million views and he made another on Saturday; he drew a pass interference call on Marlon Humphrey on a deep ball; a diving catch on an out route; and a perimeter block that sprang a Derrick Henry run. OC Declan Doyle compared him to Michael Thomas (“huge catch radius, great hands, very sticky”). ESPN has him as the favorite for the WR3 role. A third-round rookie. A huge volume of signal, but no confirmed starting job.
Se ha llevado la mayoría de las reps de: He has taken most of the early-down reps in team drills, with Alvin Kamara pushed to third downs and passing situations. That is an explicit role split, not an isolated play.
Segundo año. El OC Zac Robinson dijo que: Second year. OC Zac Robinson said he is “making explosive plays every single day” and has “great juice.” Coordinator praise, with no confirmed depth chart change.
Segundo año. Sigue mostrando explosivida: Second year. He keeps flashing explosiveness and is being tabbed as a breakout candidate, but there is no depth chart change confirmed by the staff.
Segundo año: 4 recepciones para 44 yarda: Second year: 4 catches for 44 yards in the Hall of Fame game, including a conversion on third-and-15. Canales praised his competitiveness and speed. He is second on the return depth chart behind Trevor Etienne.
Seleccion global 1. Reps en aumento desd: The No. 1 overall pick. His reps have been climbing since 8/8 and on 8/16 he produced several long plays, including two connections with Benson, though he also mishandled a snap and came close to an interception. Patra is clear: Kirk Cousins is STILL the starter. Real progression, no change at the top.
Sexta ronda de 2025 de vuelta tras lesió: A 2025 sixth-rounder back from the back injury that cost him his rookie year. Steady catches from several quarterbacks; OC Wes Phillips calls him a “really good athlete” and “a football guy.” A TE2 profile.
Susanna Weir (10/ago, dia 9, con enfasis: Susanna Weir (8/10, day 9, with an emphasis on the run game): the rookie was “heavily involved” and Sean Payton called him “a pleasant surprise.” In the same practice J.K. Dobbins left early with a soft-tissue issue and RJ Harvey worked with the second team. A direct head coach quote plus an opening created by injury.
TD de 50 yardas en ruta post profunda de: A 50-yard touchdown on a deep post from Jalen Hurts with the first team, beating Andre' Sam. Zangaro writes that he has passed Hollywood Brown in camp.
TD en salto en zona roja con dos defensi: A leaping red-zone touchdown with two defenders on him (Rakestraw and Harper) on Day 13; two days earlier he had caught two passes from Goff in the two-minute situational period.
Teresa Varley (16/ago): el novato de 2a: Teresa Varley (8/16): the second-round rookie is getting INCREASED REPS with Aaron Rodgers because of the DK Metcalf and Michael Pittman Jr. injuries. It is a real increase in reps with the starter, but one opened by absences and probably temporary. For contrast: on 8/4 Kozora described him as having a “quiet” start to camp.
The Athletic reporto que lo estan desple: The Athletic reported they are deploying him in multiple formations the way a star receiver is used: slot, jet sweeps and different backfield alignments. It was corroborated on the field on 8/4, when he ran a jet sweep out of a two-back set (Dan Hoard). It is a change in USAGE, not in the starting job, but it is the kind of detail that does move the needle for fantasy.
Tomó bastantes mas snaps que J.J. McCart: He took considerably more snaps than J.J. McCarthy in recent practices and appears to have separated in the starting competition. On 8/17 he worked with the first team in 7-on-7 and team periods, with three red-zone touchdowns to T.J. Hockenson.
UDFA (UTSA). Lideró al equipo con 174 ya: UDFA (UTSA). He led the team with 174 rushing yards and a 22-yard touchdown on the opening series against Miami. Selby highlights his “burst, decisiveness and quickness.” No confirmed move up the depth chart.
UDFA. Se ganó reps con la primera unidad: UDFA. He earned first-team reps Thursday and caught his first pass from Dak Prescott; a steady red-zone contributor with several touchdowns since camp opened.
UDFA: lideró al equipo con 5 recepciones: UDFA: he led the team with 5 catches in the 24-16 win over the Jets; in camp he made “a nifty grab in the back of the end zone” in the red zone on 8/7. A roster fight.
Volvió a 11-on-11 tras nueve meses fuera: He returned to 11-on-11 after nine months out (a November ACL): he caught all five balls thrown his way, including a 12-yard touchdown from Jordan Love on a slant. The team's plan is to raise his snap count week by week.
